title: Postcard: Glitch Sunrise
tagline: No full build today, so here is a postcard: a sun on a bad cable, over a grid that never ends.
description: Today's full build did not finish, so this page is a generative postcard instead: glitch sunrise, drawn from the date alone, animated, with a still SVG for reduced-motion and no-script visitors. Full builds resume tomorrow.
makingOf: A safety-net page. The composition (Glitch Sunrise) and its palette (split, hue 26) are chosen from the date 2026-10-17 alone (seed a4e72a2e), so the same day always draws the same picture. One scene description feeds the animated canvas, the static SVG and the thumbnail. No research and no network.
credits: Built by the Sonnet Every Day team
